messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
fort_canning | Fort Canning Park | 0 | 60 | 00:00-24:00 | -
skyline_luge | Skyline Luge Sentosa | 30 | 60 | 10:00-21:00 | -
siloso_beach | Siloso Beach | 0 | 90 | 07:00-22:00 | -
river_cruise | Singapore River Cruise | 28 | 40 | 09:00-22:30 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
skyhelix: fort_canning 23, skyline_luge 11, siloso_beach 12, river_cruise 22
fort_canning: skyhelix 23, skyline_luge 24, siloso_beach 24, river_cruise 12
skyline_luge: skyhelix 11, fort_canning 24, siloso_beach 12, river_cruise 23
siloso_beach: skyhelix 12, fort_canning 24, skyline_luge 12, river_cruise 23
river_cruise: skyhelix 22, fort_canning 12, skyline_luge 23, siloso_beach 23

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

I’ve got a window from 11:00 to 16:20 and budget isn't an issue at all. I really need to hit up SkyHelix Sentosa, Skyline Luge Sentosa, and the Singapore River Cruise. Also, I need to make sure I’m at Fort Canning Park no earlier than 11:55 and finished there by 14:25. If I can squeeze it in, I’d love to check out Siloso Beach too.

response: {"feasible":true,"visits":[{"location_id":"skyhelix","start":"11:00","end":"11:30"},{"location_id":"fort_canning","start":"11:55","end":"12:55"},{"location_id":"skyline_luge","start":"13:20","end":"14:20"},{"location_id":"river_cruise","start":"14:43","end":"15:23"}],"reason":"All mandatory places fit within the 11:00-16:20 window and Fort Canning timing; Siloso Beach could not be added without exceeding the window."}
